name: Ibraheem Shakir H
testimony:
You made me realize that I shouldn’t wait for the perfect opportunity in my career and that I should move forward with what I have in front of me right now.

I’m currently working at an MNC. Although it’s not related to what I originally wanted to pursue as a career, I don’t have to stress anymore about what I should do next. I have a stable income, and I can always try to switch to another job. Even if things don’t go as planned, I still have my current job to fall back on.

Your sessions really made me think this way. If I had never attended your classes, I would probably still be doing nothing and wasting my time on something that wouldn’t benefit me in the future.

Thank you, Vishal bro, for guiding me throughout my career journey. I’m truly grateful for your guidance and support.
